item.title: Getting the CDP Certification: 'Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)' review
item.author: quactv
item.description: 21-02-2023 / 23 Year Old Surreal. Thinking back on this cert, there are quite a few funny memories too :)) Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP) Badge here! Hold on, let me say a little about it: The CDP credential validates the practical expertise to understand, implement and manage the DevSecOps program in an organization. A CDP can assess the current state of DevSecOps, embed security as part of DevOps, manage vulnerabilities and improve the overall Maturity Level.

item.title: Getting the OSWE Certification: 'Offensive Security Web Expert' (PEN-300) review
item.author: quactv
item.description: 10-06-2022 / 22 Year Old Finally, after almost a year since I earned the OSCP certification. Today, once again I was overjoyed to get an email from Offensive letting me know I had completed and earned the OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert) certification It feels wonderful after 3 months of hard study and more than 20 hours facing a grueling, difficult exam. I’m truly grateful to Offensive for the advanced knowledge the course brought me.
